speaker_role: test-prep/consultancy marketer (Ben Wright, men's basketball recruiting coach at NCSA College Recruiting)
commercial_incentive: Yes - direct promotion of NCSA's College Search tool and website throughout
key_insights: Recommends casting a wide net when building a college list, likened to a funnel that starts broad and narrows down
Suggests including a mix of safety, realistic/target, and dream schools in an initial list
Identifies four fit criteria for evaluating schools: athletic fit, academic fit, social fit, and financial fit
Frames early list-building research as a crucial first step before reaching out to coaches (context specific to recruited athletes)
notable_or_distinctive: Framed specifically for student-athletes going through the recruiting process (athletic fit as one of four criteria) rather than general applicants.
reliability_notes: Very short, generic promotional video for NCSA's paid recruiting/search platform; content is athlete-recruiting specific rather than broadly applicable to all college list-building, and offers no data or specifics beyond a basic framework.
